title: The Lady Detectives (BBC Radio)
paragraphs: Four-part BBC Radio 4 anthology dramatizing early female-detective fiction, adapted by Roger Danes and produced by Patrick Rayner.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: BBC Radio 4 January 2005 run (January 3, 2005 to January 24, 2005) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Patrick Rayner (producer), Roger Danes (radio adaptor), Gayanne Potter (performer), Abigail Docherty (performer), Crawford Logan (performer), Eileen McCallum (performer), and Paul Young (performer).

The stories often return to women detectives in early crime fiction, Victorian and Edwardian detective fiction, inheritance, wills and financial motive, jewel theft and society crime, and Scottish law and the not-proven verdict.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes BBC Radio 4 The Lady Detectives run and BBC revival of early female detective fiction.
plain_text:
Four-part BBC Radio 4 anthology dramatizing early female-detective fiction, adapted by Roger Danes and produced by Patrick Rayner.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: BBC Radio 4 January 2005 run (January 3, 2005 to January 24, 2005) on BBC Radio 4.

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Patrick Rayner (producer), Roger Danes (radio adaptor), Gayanne Potter (performer), Abigail Docherty (performer), Crawford Logan (performer), Eileen McCallum (performer), and Paul Young (performer).

The stories often return to women detectives in early crime fiction, Victorian and Edwardian detective fiction, inheritance, wills and financial motive, jewel theft and society crime, and Scottish law and the not-proven verdict.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes BBC Radio 4 The Lady Detectives run and BBC revival of early female detective fiction.
